note: The CollegeBasketballData.com endpoints NCAAM-EARLY calls, checked against the published OpenAPI document (GET https://api.collegebasketballdata.com/api-docs.json). basketball/ncaam_early/cbbd.js refuses a path or a query parameter not listed here; tests/data.test.js checks the list. Re-verify when the spec version changes. There is NO coaches endpoint in this version: coaching records are entered by hand (manual/coaches.json).
not_in_spec: a capture time on any roster
venue coordinates (/venues: city, state, country only)
line capture times (/lines: provider, spread, overUnder, moneylines, spreadOpen, overUnderOpen)

/venues.description: Returns available venues and location information.

/games.description: Returns up to 3,000 games that match the filters, ordered by start date.

/games/teams.description: Returns team box scores and advanced metrics for up to 3,000 games that match the filters, ordered by start date.

/stats/player/season.description: Returns player statistics for a season.

/teams/roster.description: Returns team rosters for a season.

/recruiting/players.description: Returns historical composite player recruiting rankings and ratings.

/lines.description: Returns betting lines for up to 3,000 games that match the filters, ordered by start date.
